authors: Muhammad Al-Khasawneh, Pengyuan Du, Junhui Zhao, Jinsong Wu
title: UAV-Mounted Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces for Dynamic IoV Coverage
journal: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
summary: This paper explores the deployment of UAV-mounted RIS to provide dynamic network coverage for real-time mobility data exchange in the Internet of Vehicles. It emphasizes the importance of maintaining robust connectivity for CAVs in complex urban environments.

authors: Hanyu Zhang, Qimei Cui, Xiaofeng Tao, Ping Zhang
title: Small Language Models for Real-Time Edge Decision Making in 6G Vehicular Networks
summary: The authors propose utilizing small language models at the network edge to rapidly process real-time mobility data and make instantaneous decisions for cooperative driving. It highlights how C-ITS can benefit from decentralized, low-latency intelligence.

authors: Xinyu Li, Yaping Sun, Zhiyong Feng, Han Xiao
title: Next-Generation Intelligent Transportation Systems Using Multimodal Generative AI
summary: This research integrates multimodal generative AI to process massive real-time mobility data from diverse sensors on connected vehicles. It demonstrates significant improvements in traffic prediction accuracy and overall ITS reliability.

authors: Jihong Park, Sumudu Samarakoon, Mehdi Bennis, Mérouane Debbah
title: Adaptive Congestion Control for Periodic Safety Messages in Dense V2X Networks
summary: The study addresses the severe channel congestion caused by high-frequency periodic broadcasts in V2I and V2V scenarios. It proposes an adaptive demand-aware control mechanism to reduce unnecessary transmissions and mitigate packet collisions.

authors: Yuxuan Sun, Sheng Zhou, Zhisheng Niu, Deniz Gündüz
title: Overcoming Cellular Bottlenecks in V2N Communications via Edge-Assisted V2I Offloading
summary: This paper analyzes the cost and latency bottlenecks inherent in pure Cellular V2N communication for vehicular tracking. It proposes a localized V2I offloading framework to alleviate core network backhaul congestion and reduce monetary costs.

authors: Lingjie Duan, Lin Gao, Jianwei Huang
title: Energy-Efficient Resource Allocation for Periodic Status Updates in V2I Networks
summary: The authors highlight the critical power waste issues caused by indiscriminate periodic broadcasting of mobility status by vehicles. They develop an energy-efficient scheduling algorithm that balances update frequency with the limited energy resources of CAVs.

authors: Amir Hossein Arani, Halim Yanikomeroglu, Nizar Zorba
title: A Resilient AoI-Aware Optimization Framework for Intelligent Transportation Systems Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
journal: IEEE Open Journal of the Communications Society
summary: This paper proposes a DDPG-based resilient optimization framework to handle AoI violations in vehicular networks. It dynamically adjusts communication resources to maintain information freshness under stochastic traffic conditions.

authors: Zhaolong Ning, Hao Wu, Xiaojie Wang, Lei Guo
title: Age and Power Minimization via Meta-Deep Reinforcement Learning in Vehicular Edge Computing
summary: The study utilizes meta-DRL to jointly minimize the age of information and power consumption in vehicular edge computing scenarios. It effectively addresses scheduling challenges by adapting to rapidly changing network environments.

authors: Qimei Cui, Hanyu Zhang, Yaping Sun, Xiaofeng Tao
title: Scheduling for Maximizing Information Freshness in V2I Systems via Branch-Network DRL
journal: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
summary: The authors introduce a novel branch-network DRL approach with action masking to optimize uplink scheduling in V2I networks. The scheme explicitly targets the minimization of AoI while preventing redundant status updates.
